Omar (PM): TL;DR: We need a pilot playbook that is scoreable, has hard gates (no soft-commit), and an escalation matrix if infra or privacy issues appear. I sketched OKRs and consent language. Need quick feedback so outreach can go live Friday.

Jules (GTM): Love hard gates. For outreach, we should promise 3 deliverables: onboarding runbook, weekly signal pack, and a 1-page migration plan at the end. That sets expectation bar.

Kai (Eng): From infra: propose a strict capacity gate: only orgs with baseline monthly token volume < 200M or who can commit to a dry-run on our sandbox. Otherwise we can't guarantee SLOs.

Rina (Security): For privacy: pilots must pick one of three telemetry profiles on signup: Minimal (aggregates only), Standard (aggregates + sampled outputs, opt-in), or Custodian (customer-hosted logs via S3/KMS). Include explicit retention windows.

Tess (CS): On engagement: require a named technical lead + weekly 60-min working session for first 3 weeks. If they miss 2 sessions in the first month, they drop to standby. Need that in the form.

Omar (PM): OKRs (pilot cohort):
- O1: Validate product signal sufficiency: collect >=10 distinct feature asks with reproducible steps by cohort end
- O2: Performance target: median p95 latency improvement of >=20% vs baseline for at least 60% of migrated routes
- O3: Adoption signal: >=50% of active starters open a conversion discussion (Dedicated or contract) within 90 days
Metric thresholds will be pass/fail per org; cohort success if >=60% of orgs pass O1 and O2.

Jules (GTM): Outreach incentive: $4k credit + case study (optional). We'll say "limited seats" and ask for a 3-min workflow video.

Kai (Eng): Gating checklist (must be completed before SE intro):
1) Completed intake form with baseline metrics (p95 baseline, monthly tokens, routes)
2) Completed `redwood-eval --suite pilot-gate --routes routes.json --out results.json` and upload results.json
3) Chosen telemetry profile and signed consent checkbox
4) Named tech lead + business sponsor

Tess (CS): Enforcement: if gate 2 fails (eval exceeds our allowed p95 by >2x), we offer sandbox assistance and a delayed kickoff, not immediate rejection.

Rina (Security): Consent snippet to include on the form (short):

"I consent to Redwood collecting aggregated performance metrics (latency histograms, token counts). I understand sampled outputs are optional and retained up to 30 days unless otherwise agreed. For customer-hosted logs, Redwood will store logs in customer-provided S3 with KMS."

Omar (PM): Escalation matrix (internal):
- Level 1 (SE/Tess): troubleshooting during working session -> resolve within 24h or escalate
- Level 2 (Eng/Kai): infra bug/rollback -> 8h response SLA, aim fix or rollback within 48h
- Level 3 (Security/Rina): data privacy/legal hold -> immediate pause of sampling, notify customer and legal; patch/mitigation plan within 72h
We should include contact rotation and pager in the onboarding doc.

Jules (GTM): Outreach: short plain copy suggestion:
"Hi <Name>,
Were recruiting a small pilot to validate production inference performance. Limited seats. Quick 5-min form + 3-min video: share your route, p95 baseline, and biggest blocker. We provide onboarding + $4k credit. Interested?"

Kai (Eng): Also add a short checklist for us to triage pre-accept: scorecard (0-4) on Impact, Readiness, Compliance, OpsRisk. Require minimum total 8 and not flagged as high OpsRisk without sandbox commitment.

Tess (CS): Feedback cadence (customer-facing): Daily slack channel during week0 onboarding, twice-weekly 30-min sync weeks 1-2, weekly 60-min after. Weekly partner quickform (5 Qs) and monthly retrospective.

Omar (PM): Reporting pack we deliver weekly: perf snapshot (p50/p95/p99), cost per token estimate, prompt-regression table, open action items with owners and ETA. Make it a template in repo.

Rina (Security): Legal/retention addendum: sampled outputs default retention 30 days; if customer requests >30d, require AD and signed addendum. Also add a clause: Redwood will not use sampled outputs to train public models unless explicit opt-in.

Jules (GTM): Timeline: finalize playbook Thu -> outreach Fri morning -> form open 10 days -> shortlist -> kickoff 2 weeks from close.

Omar (PM): Action items: Kai: add eval gate command + pass thresholds to repo by EOD; Rina: telemetry profiles + consent language by EOD; Tess: engagement SLA + escalation contact table by Thu; Jules: outreach + incentive copy Fri AM. I'll publish final playbook and cohort sheet once those land.
